newsitem.title: USA: N.Y. Fed Press Briefing - May 15.
newsitem.headline: N.Y. Fed Press Briefing - May 15.

text.p: The Federal Reserve said it had no large one day net misses in its reserve projections in the latest week, a Fed spokeswoman said.
The high in natural float was about $825 million on Tuesday, while the low in natural float was about $100 million on Friday.
Transporation float averaged about $3.0 million per day with the high on Tuesday at about $10 million primarily due to capacity problems on airplanes flying from Cleveland to the Milwaukee area.
